useful_backend_gain: LDA minus raw cross-script macro AUC >= 0.01
substantial_backend_gain: LDA minus raw cross-script macro AUC >= 0.03
wgc_complementarity_rule: After LDA, WGC should remain above the matched-control LDA cross-script macro AUC; condition-level changes will be inspected to ensure the difference is not driven by one condition.

interpretation_cases.backend_bottleneck_supported: LDA gives a substantial gain for both encoders.
interpretation_cases.partial_backend_bottleneck: LDA gives a useful but less than 0.03 gain.
interpretation_cases.wgc_complementary: WGC remains better than control after applying the same LDA backend.
interpretation_cases.wgc_not_complementary: WGC advantage disappears or reverses after LDA.
